name: Ayase Chisato
source: Ryuuichi's and Aoi's classmate, as well as the only "normal" girl of the chuunibyuu girls and the one with the most common sense. She mostly takes care of the dorm's housework. Despite this, she has a secret she cannot tell anyone about...
